statement: Let L be a finite extension of Q5 containing µ5, with valuation ring R and residue field k. Let X → Spec R be a smooth projective morphism of relative dimension one with geometrically integral fibers C = XL, D = Xk. For a closed point q of C, let r(q) be its specialization on D: it is the image of the closed point under the unique extension of Spec κ(q) → X to the valuation ring of κ(q). For a closed point r of D, write [r] ∈ Pic(D) for the class of the divisor (r). Let m ≥ 0 be an integer, and suppose that: 1. U is the spectrum of an arbitrary localization of the coordinate ring of a nonempty affine open of C, and p1, . . . , pm are distinct L-rational closed points of U; 2. Z is a finite set of closed points of D, and every closed point q of C with r(q) / ∈ Z belongs to U; 3. B is an abelian group killed by 5, and ψ : Pic(D) → B is a homomorphism satisfying ψ([r]) = 0 for every r ∈ Z. Put ri = r(pi) ∈ D(k). Choose βL ∈ K2(L; 5) with ∂coefβL = [ζ] for a primitive fifth root of unity ζ, and let b be multiplication by its restrictions, with b2 = b ◦ b. Let vL be the normalized valuation of L. For ai ∈ L× and ei ∈ F5, the condition m X i=1 eivL(ai) ψ([ri]) ̸= 0 in B (4.1) implies m X i=1 (pi)∗ eib2 [ai]5  ̸= 0 in G5(U; 5). (4.2) Here [ai]5 is the class of ai in K1(L; 5) = L×/L×5, and the scalars in (4.1) act through the natural F5-module structure on B.
